tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind every panel. Ink and muted text read on it; faint text does not (2.97:1).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, KPI cards, header bar, inputs, secondary buttons, the user's chat bubble.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Resting search inputs, segmented-control track, expanded row detail panel.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of progress bars (7px / 6px rails).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px border of every panel, card, input, chip and tab at rest; table header underline.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Row separators inside panels and tables, chat header/composer dividers, bar-chart baseline.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on canvas, surface and every tinted alert ground (14:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: leads, KPI labels, alert bodies, table cells, inactive tab labels. 5.5:1 or better on surface, canvas and all tone grounds.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Meta lines, table column headers, KPI sub-lines, hints, chevrons. 3.33:1 on surface — below 4.5:1; kept exactly from the source. Use it only for non-essential meta, never on canvas.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Null values (the em-dash in a table), empty-state lines. Decorative contrast only (2.3:1).

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Logo tile, avatar, active tab/chip fill, primary button, above-average bars, progress fills, key figures in tables, links. White on navy reads 10.3:1.

tokens.name: navy-deep
tokens.usage: Hover of primary buttons and links; text on navy-tint (banner copy, AI chat text, suggestion questions).

tokens.name: navy-tint
tokens.usage: Sync/import banner ground, AI chat bubble, expanded table row, info insight card, hover of outline controls, TN badge ground.

tokens.name: navy-tint-border
tokens.usage: Border under the banner and around info insight cards.

tokens.name: navy-line
tokens.usage: Border of the ghost button inside the banner and of the AI chat bubble.

tokens.name: navy-soft
tokens.usage: Bars at or below the average in the monthly bar chart. Decorative, never text.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and initials on navy fills.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Gains and good news: positive deltas, ‘Bonne nouvelle’ kicker and dot. 6.2:1 on positive-bg.

tokens.name: positive-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a positive insight card.

tokens.name: positive-border
tokens.usage: Border of a positive insight card.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: The ‘connected / live’ status (pulsing dot + label) and the neutral ‘Constat’ insight tone from the price database demo. A second green that drifted from `positive`; keep it for live status only.

tokens.name: observation-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a ‘Constat’ insight card (price database).

tokens.name: observation-border
tokens.usage: Border of a ‘Constat’ insight card.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Losses and risks: negative deltas, ‘À surveiller’ kicker, a client over the dependency threshold. 5.1:1 on negative-bg.

tokens.name: negative-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a negative insight card.

tokens.name: negative-border
tokens.usage: Border of a negative insight card.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Vigilance: credit notes, dependency, ‘À challenger’; text of the TS (travaux supplémentaires) badge. 4.75:1 on warning-bg.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning insight card and of the TS badge.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Border of a warning insight card.

tokens.name: scrollbar
tokens.usage: Scrollbar thumb (8px, radius 4px). Alias of border.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per view, a short full sentence ending with a period.

styles.name: kpi-value
styles.usage: The figure in a KPI card (global views).

styles.name: kpi-value-sm
styles.usage: KPI figure when five cards share a row (monthly view).

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Right-aligned figure in a stat row (récurrent / ponctuel).

styles.name: figure-sm
styles.usage: Per-zone price inside an expanded row.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Title of every panel.

styles.name: delta
styles.usage: Euro delta in a hausses/baisses list, coloured positive or negative.

styles.name: app-title
styles.usage: Product name beside the logo tile in the header.

styles.name: logo-initials
styles.usage: Two client initials in the 46px navy logo tile.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Les quatre heures de tableur deviennent une page.
styles.usage: Under the page title, ink-muted, max 780px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tout est calculé depuis l'extraction comptable.
styles.usage: Default text; insight titles use it at 600.

styles.name: chat
styles.usage: Chat bubble text; also list item names at 600.

styles.name: row
styles.usage: Table rows, tabs (600), panel sub-lines, progress labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Alert bodies, KPI sub-lines, panel descriptions, chips (600).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: KPI label in ink-muted; secondary table cells at 400.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Header subtitle, list sub-lines, banner button (600).

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase: insight kickers, table column headers, zone labels.

styles.name: group-label
styles.usage: Uppercase navy label that opens a family of rows in a table.

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: Pill badges and the user-chip status line.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Every euro amount, price, date and invoice number in a table column, right-aligned.

styles.name: amount-key
styles.usage: The key column (prix moyen, total facturé) in navy.

styles.name: bar-value
styles.usage: Value label above a bar in the monthly chart.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Segmented control inner padding; row side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between nav tabs; dot-to-kicker gap.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between filters, between bars in the chart.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between insight cards and table columns.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between KPI cards and between side-by-side panels.

tokens.name: space-22
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between panels; KPI card padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-26
tokens.usage: Below the page heading and the KPI row.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Page side gutter (desktop).

tokens.name: space-30
tokens.usage: Top padding of the main column.

tokens.name: content-width
tokens.usage: Max width of header, banner and main column.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Segmented options; top corners of chart bars (6 6 2 2).

tokens.name: radius-7
tokens.usage: Ghost button inside the banner.

tokens.name: radius-8
tokens.usage: Nav tabs, outline buttons, the user chip.

tokens.name: radius-9
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, primary button, logo tile, suggestion cards, segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-10
tokens.usage: Insight cards, expanded-row detail panels.

tokens.name: radius-11
tokens.usage: Chat bubbles (the corner nearest the speaker drops to 3px).

tokens.name: radius-12
tokens.usage: Panels and KPI cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Month chips, progress rails, badges, dots.

shadow.note: The system has no elevation. Separation comes from 1px borders on a canvas ground.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: Every surface. Use border, not shadow.
